Priya / Marta — dug into the ask and the historical partner programs. Short answer: we can approve a cohort-level sponsorship with one of two flows:

Option A (preferred, faster): Redwood issues a single cohort promo code that entitles each enrolled company to X credits. Partner provides final roster; we issue codes in bulk via the partner console.
Option B: Redwood issues per-company codes individually after verification (slower, but gives finer controls).

For Ember specifically I can provisionally sign off on a cohort package of up to 250,000 total platform credits, allocated as 15k credits per company for up to 15 companies (we can reassign leftover credits to a waitlist). Conditions:
- We need the final roster no later than 2026-12-20
- Each startup must accept standard PLG terms; Ember may submit a signed partner MOU if they'd prefer to operate under a single umbrella (we'll need PO or MOU for invoicing if Ember will handle billing)
- Credits expire 12 months from issuance

Attachments to our internal approval: redwood_credits_terms.pdf (contains per-credit usage guidance and non-exhaustive T&Cs).

If Priya and Marissa are good with that package, Ill generate the cohort promo code and a CSV we can hand to Ember for distribution.
